name: Cast Light
source:
College student Nick takes his sister out for trick or treating while dressed as a vampire.
While moping around as usual, he ends up meeting a real vampire in the flesh.
Watch over him as he navigates his way through the strangest night of his life!

[From [url=https://deletedelight.itch.io/cast-light]itch.io[/url]]
